gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-006 diagnoses a scalar normalization inconsistency between the discrete normal-cycle formula and its metric theorem. It does not recognize the missing triangle-area factors required for surface-measure quadrature, nor the resulting count-weighted estimator.

Both entries identify the incorrect evaluation of the specified half-circle/semicircle vector integral: the value is 2β_T rather than (π/2)β_T. They also identify propagation of that factor into cylindrical weights and the corresponding repair.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The cylindrical half-circle vector integral is miscomputed, causing all downstream cylindrical atom weights and pairings to carry the wrong normalization.

component_coverage.gold_component: The specified cylindrical semicircle has vector integral 2β_T, not (π/2)β_T, and this normalization error propagates to cylindrical atoms and pairings.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-004 explicitly computes the half-circle integral as 2β_T rather than (π/2)β_T and states that the resulting wrong edge weight propagates through the cylindrical and compressed representations.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 raises a general sign ambiguity for wedge-defined currents on unoriented sets and proposes imposing an orientation convention. It does not diagnose the specific algebraic error that the displayed cylindrical basis has negative orientation or identify the required replacement of a×u by −a×u.

ISSUE-010 concerns the missing consistency estimate between a discrete delta-sum functional and the normal cycle of an underlying smooth shape. It does not identify the separate midpoint quadrature error on each cylindrical edge or the unjustified equality asserting that the surrogate equals the exact embedded normal cycle.
